semanticChecks.samePetCandidateRepair: 14-feierling-E references a newly generated current-batch candidate to repair cropped framing; candidate source and receipt are preserved.
semanticChecks.modelHonesty: All actualModel/actualQuality and unavailable submitted selectors remain null; configuration targets are kept separate.
semanticChecks.routeNormalization: builtin and builtin-host-managed both represent the tool-managed builtin route; no API/CLI found.
